title: Tukar demo, second cut
note: One source of truth. vo.py speaks `vo`, capture.mjs runs `id` against the real app, Remotion lays the capture into the kraft world and burns `captions`. Scene length follows the narration; if the real capture ran longer (a proof, a ledger wait) the composition speeds that clip up and says by how much on screen.

acts.title: Proof you can check
acts.sub: verify / tamper / audit request / travel rule

scenes.vo: This is Tukar, a private remittance corridor on Stellar. Everything here runs on public testnet, and every receipt is one you can check yourself.
captions: This is Tukar, a private remittance corridor on Stellar.
Everything here runs on public testnet,
and every receipt is one you can check yourself.

scenes.vo: A sender connects a testnet key in one tap. Two hundred dollars to Mexico, with the corridor's cap read from an on-chain policy registry.
captions: A sender connects a testnet key in one tap.
Two hundred dollars to Mexico,
with the corridor's cap read from an on-chain policy registry.

scenes.vo: The compliance proof is built on the phone: allow-listed, not sanctioned, bound to this key. It really takes about thirty seconds, so the clip runs fast and says so.
captions: The compliance proof is built on the phone: allow-listed, not sanctioned, bound to this key.
It really takes about thirty seconds, so the clip runs fast and says so.

scenes.vo: Real testnet USDC enters the shielded pool and the note joins the Merkle tree. The ledger carries a commitment, not an amount or a recipient.
captions: Real testnet USDC enters the shielded pool and the note joins the Merkle tree.
The ledger carries a commitment, not an amount or a recipient.

scenes.vo: The receiver claims with a bearer note. No seed phrase, and no account with us.
captions: The receiver claims with a bearer note.
No seed phrase, and no account with us.

scenes.vo: The payout rate is read on-chain from Reflector, and the withdraw fails closed when the live quote sits under the contract's floor.
captions: The payout rate is read on-chain from Reflector,
and the withdraw fails closed when the live quote sits under the contract's floor.

scenes.vo: The withdraw settles on-chain, and only at that edge does an amount become public. That edge is what a compliance officer works with.
captions: The withdraw settles on-chain, and only at that edge does an amount become public.
That edge is what a compliance officer works with.

scenes.vo: The holder discloses one fact on the device: an exact amount, a threshold, a range, or an aggregate. Not a key, and not their history.
captions: The holder discloses one fact on the device:
an exact amount, a threshold, a range, or an aggregate.
Not a key, and not their history.

scenes.vo: A regulator pastes the receipt. It is checked twice, in the browser and by the same verifier contract the pool calls.
captions: A regulator pastes the receipt.
It is checked twice, in the browser and by the same verifier contract the pool calls.

scenes.vo: Change one character and it is rejected. A proof that verifies but is not bound to on-chain state is rejected too, and named as that.
captions: Change one character and it is rejected.
A proof that verifies but is not bound to on-chain state is rejected too, and named as that.

scenes.vo: A view-only note opens the payment without being able to spend it, and recomputes the commitment the pool stored.
captions: A view-only note opens the payment without being able to spend it,
and recomputes the commitment the pool stored.

scenes.vo: Here is the piece worth arguing about. The auditor picks the payments and registers the request on-chain, so the answer is bound to that set and nothing can be left out of it. The honest scope sits beside it: the set is built from public deposits.
captions: Here is the piece worth arguing about.
The auditor picks the payments and registers the request on-chain,
so the answer is bound to that set and nothing can be left out of it.
The honest scope sits beside it: the set is built from public deposits.

scenes.vo: The Travel Rule leg speaks real TRP three point two one with IVMS101 payloads. The panel beside it says the TRISA node is not deployed yet.
captions: The Travel Rule leg speaks real TRP three point two one with IVMS101 payloads.
The panel beside it says the TRISA node is not deployed yet.

scenes.vo: The export is jurisdiction-shaped, and where a shielded amount makes a threshold untestable it says so instead of guessing.
captions: The export is jurisdiction-shaped,
and where a shielded amount makes a threshold untestable it says so instead of guessing.

scenes.vo: The operator desk reads the pool live: reserves attested against an exact liability accumulator, and every deployed contract id on screen.
captions: The operator desk reads the pool live:
reserves attested against an exact liability accumulator,
and every deployed contract id on screen.

scenes.vo: Per-corridor policy comes from the registry on-chain, and the oracle card shows the median the pool settles against, with its staleness window.
captions: Per-corridor policy comes from the registry on-chain,
and the oracle card shows the median the pool settles against, with its staleness window.

scenes.vo: Monitoring is live and read-only, and states its own limits: a daily cadence, and thresholds left unset because there is no traffic to baseline against.
captions: Monitoring is live and read-only, and states its own limits:
a daily cadence, and thresholds left unset
because there is no traffic to baseline against.

scenes.vo: Anyone can check a receipt without a wallet, on a public page, straight against Soroban RPC.
captions: Anyone can check a receipt without a wallet,
on a public page, straight against Soroban RPC.

scenes.vo: The documentation site carries the architecture, the threat model, the test plan, and how to reproduce the deployed contracts.
captions: The documentation site carries the architecture, the threat model, the test plan,
and how to reproduce the deployed contracts.

scenes.vo: Fifteen contracts, eight circuits, real testnet money, and no users yet. The last one is said out loud. Private in the middle, accountable at the edges.
captions: Fifteen contracts, eight circuits, real testnet money, and no users yet.
The last one is said out loud.
Private in the middle, accountable at the edges.
